prompt:
VISUAL WORLD (identical across all three comps): a premium, minimal, thoughtful wedding-planning website in the spirit of YourDay and Loverly. Warm ivory page ground (#FBF8F3). Deep wine accent (#5E1F33) for the logo mark, primary buttons and small highlights. Soft pastel section washes used sparingly: blush (#F4E4E1) and sage (#E4EAE0). Headlines in a refined, high-contrast editorial serif with one elegant italic accent word; body and UI text in a clean, quiet sans-serif, generous line height. Pill-shaped buttons: primary filled wine with ivory text, secondary thin wine outline. Hairline dividers, very generous whitespace, soft diffused shadows, rounded 16px cards. Calm, romantic, uncluttered; no gradients, no neon, no dark mode, no emoji, no stock icons grid, no sponsor logos, no fake testimonials, no statistics.
Brand: the logo is the word "PlusOne" set in the serif, with "One" in italic wine. Tagline headline text exactly: "Your AI copilot for the perfect wedding."
Crisp, legible, pixel-perfect website UI screenshot, 16:9 desktop viewport 1440x900, flat front-on view, no browser frame, no device mockup, no perspective.
A desktop landing page hero, composition C "the tour is the hero", very minimal, layout:
1) Top navigation bar: "PlusOne" logo left; right side links "How it works", "Sign in" and a filled wine pill "Start planning".
2) Upper-left: large serif headline on two lines "Your AI copilot for the perfect wedding." (word "perfect" in wine italic) and a one-line sans subtitle "Five calm steps from your wedding date to a booked vendor."
3) Center of the page, spanning the full width inside margins: a horizontal guided tour made of five numbered steps connected by a fine hairline, each step a small rounded ivory card with a delicate line icon and a short title and one line: "1 Describe your wedding — date, city, days, budget", "2 Find vendors — we read real vendor websites", "3 Contact them — emails sent from your wedding inbox", "4 Compare quotes — replies read, budget updated", "5 Decide — mark the one you love as booked". Step 3 is the active step: its card is gently lifted with a soft blush wash and wine number badge, and directly beneath it an enlarged preview card shows an email draft: "To: Lumen & Lace Photography · Subject: Photography for our wedding, 14 March" with two lines of friendly email text and a wine pill "Approve & send".
4) Bottom row: filled wine pill "Start planning" and outline pill "Play the tour", centered, with a tiny caption "No card needed".
A sprig of delicate watercolor eucalyptus in the bottom-right corner, very subtle. Focal moment: the step-3 card with its email preview.
